title: Deep Cradle
shortDescription: A round silk chamber under the nave, built for something larger.
longDescription:
The silk closes into a round room. Larger cocoons hang unopened. One has split along a seam. A dark, patient shape fills the gap.
The air is warm. Three pulses travel the floor. This is not a throne. Alder said she will not wake for one Collegian, and the room agrees.

fixtures.name: Still Score
fixtures.examineDescription: A thread-chart is pinned to the silk. Three notes are marked. A fourth space is blank and warm under your paw. Alder cannot see this from the High Study. This is the part he sent a party to read.
